verdict.rationale: New Relic exposes NerdGraph, a documented GraphQL API for querying metrics, logs, and traces, plus NRQL for structured queries, and now an official MCP server that lets external AI agents connect and convert natural-language questions into NRQL for troubleshooting production issues. This directly matches the story of an external agent querying telemetry through documented APIs to debug production. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the MCP server/API reliability from third parties beyond vendor docs.
